source.basis: Operator facility page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

reading.body:
Stack Infrastructure's POR01 campus in Hillsboro occupies 65,000 square feet of technical space. The operator has not published a megawatt figure for this facility on its spec page, so no IT load, critical power, or utility capacity can be stated. Without a power figure, no translation into rack count or accelerator density is possible.

The absence of a published megawatt figure places POR01 outside the six Oregon facilities that have published capacity numbers, which together total 182 MW across this site's readings. Among the 133 mapped Oregon facilities, only six carry a published MW figure at all, so POR01 is in the majority in that respect. This site cannot assign POR01 a rank by power among Oregon campuses because the necessary data point is not published.

On certifications, none are listed in the published specifications, so no statement can be made about what compliance tiers or redundancy standards the campus meets. A reader evaluating POR01 for AI workloads, which require both dense power delivery and known uptime guarantees, is working with one published fact: 65,000 square feet of technical space. That floor area is a necessary condition for a meaningful facility but is not sufficient to assess AI hosting suitability without the power and certification data the operator has not released here.
